question: Whether this lane adopts an affirmative keep-building-the-toolbox directive under Rule 12
adopted_practice: Keep building tools toward named consumer paths; a check-before-building gate alone is insufficient.

boundary.build: Named consumer, known-bad RED arm, and receipt for the observed gate.
boundary.hold: Instrument has no consumer or gates nothing; wire or repair it before adding another.
boundary.audit: Process audit drifts at USER 0 / ENABLER 5 / PROCESS 17 or worse, or at least two instruments remain unconsumed.

reasoning: Rule 12 makes ADOPT the default and disqualifies scale and smallness as refusals.
The measured process-porn audit is a phase signal, not evidence that useful tooling should stop.
Two of four instruments currently gate nothing, so unconditional growth would create more ceremony instead of consumer value.
The smallest honest adoption keeps the affirmative direction while requiring consumer, RED arm, and receipt evidence.
no_claim: This does not authorize unbounded tool proliferation.
This does not claim the two unconsumed instruments are fixed.
This does not replace the measured process audit.
